mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand expansion, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0, sustained over two consecutive months, signals a contraction in manufacturing output, increasing the probability of an upcoming recession and triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, the market prices in a high-cost environment that suppresses corporate profitability and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 345,000 million dollars, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0%, signals weakening consumer demand and labor market stress, which increases the risk of earnings downgrades and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 345000.0 and UNRATE > 5.0, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong economic momentum, which increases corporate earnings visibility and reduces risk aversion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
